wall_timing_scope: Contended host: nominal mission running concurrently; not a clean throughput benchmark

plan.scope: Numerical consistency and falsification probes; research only

cases.freefall: 0.5 s, no drag or thrust; compare vz and z with analytic gravity
cases.hover: 8 s upright hover, command at 20 Hz; compare trace and steady drift
cases.velocity_brake: 1 s hover, 3 s at 2 m/s, 4 s zero velocity; measure overshoot
cases.expired_command: 4 s at 4 m/s, then no refresh for 4 s; measure delay and stopping
cases.motor_lag: 0.2 s held 5 N-per-rotor override; compare exact exponential thrust
cases.constant_wind: 8 s hover in 3 m/s crosswind; compare drift and steady error
cases.touchdown: Unpowered drop from COM 3 m onto plane; compare impulse/settling
cases.frame_signs: One raw-thrust step at initial yaw 0 and 90 deg; compare body torque signs

interpretation: Compare identical commands at exact physical times, independent of integrator rate.
Report errors and nonconvergence; do not retune gains or tolerances after seeing results.
Contact impulses may not converge pointwise; compare event time, total response and rest state.
No noisy sensors, estimated state, downwash, urban wind, battery circuit, or physical data.
